messages:
tayla_r: Quick follow-up from the PM: overnight we saw repeated pages from short CPU spikes and autoscaler flapping. Need owners for alert edits (dedupe, thresholds, routing).

ben_w: Can you list the changes you want?

tayla_r: 1) dedupe by stack_hash+hostpool instead of service. 2) transient spike alerts -> require 3/5 1m windows. 3) add 4m cooldown for autoscale alerts during backups. 4) stop dual routing to infra-oncall + infra-ops. 5) nightly prune job to collapse dup alerts >1h.

zoe_k: I can take (1) and (5). Will add a script to compress duplicates into a single incident and update alert config. Due: 2026-03-29.

ben_w: I'll take (2) and (4). Implement bucketed rule and routing change; will run a 48h canary on payments-service. Due: 2026-03-27.

oncall-bot: Postmortem linked PMT-2026-0791. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/alerts/2026-03-noisefix

tayla_r: Lina: backup windows are daily 00:30-01:30 UTC and Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC 9 add suppression during those windows.

ben_w: I'll add the autoscale cooldown config with guard and coordinate rollback steps.

zoe_k: Adding CI test for dedupe change so we don't accidentally group unrelated errors.

tayla_r: Success criteria: 72h post-rollout noise check; pages/day down >50% and no regression in p95 latency. Closing actions after observation window.
